issues: React Flow warning: 'It looks like you\'ve created a new nodeTypes or edgeTypes object. If this wasn\'t on purpose please define the nodeTypes/edgeTypes outside of the component or memoize them.' — in /app/frontend/src/components/Canvas/CanvasArea.jsx the nodeTypes/edgeTypes objects are declared at module scope so this warning is likely triggered by StrictMode double-render; still worth verifying with useMemo or confirming module-level constants are used correctly.
